title: Patient Reported Outcome Feedback in Hypopituitarism
summary: It has been increasingly established that the treatment of patients with insufficiency of the pituitary gland (hypopituitarism) must also include the patient's lived reality in order to make progress with regard to efficient therapeutic approaches. This study examines whether communicating quality of life information to the treating physician can improve the management of patients with hypopituitarism.
criteria:
